description: Topaz / Ruan Mei / Robin / Aventurine — multi-enemy (1 boss + 2 elites), ~3 cycles in reference UI
captureNotes: Extracted via .tmp/ext/extract-battle-record.cjs from raw log at .tmp/raw-battle-log-topaz.json. Some relic 4pc sets (Ruan Mei, Robin, Aventurine) inferred from canonical builds since passive 4pc bonuses don't emit BuffApply entries. enemySpd/enemyMaxToughness averaged across boss (SPD 158, tough 140) and 2 elites (SPD 132, tough 100). Substats are synthesized by buildFixtures.defaultRollLayout (1 high roll per priority substat per relic; ~4 rolls per substat per character total) — this is a placeholder until a real Kel-Z dump of the captured player's relics is added alongside the golden. totalDamage tolerance is wider (35%) to absorb the placeholder calibration drift; tighten once real relic data lands.
expectedDrift: slot0 (Topaz): our sim folds Numby memo damage into primary FUA. Reference splits primary (~374k) from memo (~1.12M). Per-slot combined totals match within ~10%.

slot1 (Ruan Mei): break-zone passive (Thanataplum Rebloom) wired via onEnemyWeaknessRecovery in #5 — procs land but each is ~6x lower magnitude than reference (18k total vs 119k). Likely cause: kit-specific break-amp scaling on her break-zone procs (e.g. ascension-passive break-damage multiplier) that the generic resolveBreak path doesn't apply. Per-character refinement is follow-up work.
slot2 (Robin): missing ~430k UNIQUE damage from Flowing Nightglow LC (per-teammate-attack Additional proc not yet triggered on teammate actions; see issue #3).

slot3 (Aventurine): tracks reference within ~2% after #7 (broken-state bonus). Now runs +40% over reference after #10 (per-enemy clocks): his fuaStackPool.onEnemyTurnApprox=1.3 fires on every per-enemy turn, so a 3-enemy scenario gains ~3x his stacks per real-time window. v1 calibration limitation — characters tuned against single-enemy goldens run hot in multi-enemy scenarios until re-calibrated.

slot0 BREAK: per-enemy gauges now credit each attacker independently. Topaz only breaks the boss (toughness 140) via her single-target attacks; AoE breakers (Aventurine, Ruan Mei) break the elites. Expect slot0 BREAK to drop substantially from the old +178% over-attribution.
